text:
sam_h: Hey support — since the 14:20 UTC deploy yesterday we started seeing intermittent 401s on /v1/generate and the audit logs for those requests appear to be missing. Customer is escalating. example curl + response below, trace id 35f2a9c8

sam_h: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl","input":"hello"}'```

sam_h: Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_client", "trace_id":"35f2a9c8"}

maria_g: Sorry about that — we'll take this high priority. Can you paste the exact response headers and the approximate 5–10 minute window for the events? @chris_t FYI infra.

sam_h: Window was ~2026-03-10T14:20:30Z to 2026-03-10T14:28:00Z. No config changes on our side, using hosted API. Headers: `x-request-id: 35f2a9c8`, `x-region: us-west-2`.

maria_g: Thanks. We'll try to reproduce. If you can keep request samples coming that helps. @chris_t can you pull gateway and audit pipeline for that window?

chris_t: On it. I'll kick a log export now.

chris_t: ```redwoodctl logs export --from 2026-03-10T14:20:00Z --to 2026-03-10T14:40:00Z --trace-id 35f2a9c8 --out /tmp/35f2a9c8.zip```

audit-bot: Export queued — artifact will be available at https://internal-exports.redwood/sup/35f2a9c8.zip (expires in 7d).

chris_t: Got partial gateway logs. For trace 35f2a9c8 we see the gateway received the request, forwarded to auth-service which returned a 401 after a KMS decrypt error; upstream (model) had some 502s in same window but those are separate. It looks like intermittent KMS unwrap failures. @alex_k can you check KMS/HSM audit?

alex_k: I can confirm there were decrypt errors for key `proj/keys/api-traffic` around 2026-03-10T14:21:12Z — error message indicates key version mismatch during unwrap. Also I don't see corresponding audit pipeline entries for some of those requests (possible ingestion delay/drop). For ISO evidence we'll need: key rotation history, KMS access logs for that window, and signed statement of rotation policy.

maria_g: Customer asked for ISO27001 evidence items: log retention policy, proof audit logs exist for the date range, key management/rotation, KMS access control list. I'll assemble. @alex_k please export KMS access logs for 2026-03-10T14:00:00Z -> 2026-03-10T15:00:00Z and include key version table.

alex_k: Export started. Command I ran:
```/usr/local/bin/kmsctl audit-export --key proj/keys/api-traffic --from 2026-03-10T14:00:00Z --to 2026-03-10T15:00:00Z --format jsonl --out s3://redwood-compliance/exports/35f2a9c8-kms.jsonl```
I will include: key id, versions, creation timestamps, rotation schedule, and HSM vendor attestation.

sam_h: Also saw a billing spike during retries in that window — requests retried and counted twice. Can we reconcile charges?

chris_t: Yes retries caused duplicate token counts. We'll record this incident as billing-impacting and include a reconciliation. Short-term mitigation: reduce retry TTL and add idempotency token. Long-term: dedupe at gateway.

alex_k: KMS export done: https://internal-exports.redwood/sup/35f2a9c8-kms.jsonl. Rotation: last rotated 2026-02-01T03:00:00Z, rotation policy 90 days. HSM vendor: Thales Luna; key material never exported from HSM. Access control: only `kms-admins` and `secure-ops` have decrypt rights.

audit-bot: Audit export complete: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/35f2a9c8.zip — retention tag: 395 days.

maria_g: For ISO mapping I'll draft the incident timeline and map controls: A.12.4 (event logging), A.11.2 (cryptographic controls), plus evidence attachments (log export, KMS audit, rotation note, incident RCA, billing reconciliation).

sam_h: ETA for the compliance packet? The ISO reviewer asked for everything by EOD tomorrow if possible.

maria_g: I'll assemble the compliance packet and upload by EOD tomorrow. Packet will include: exported logs, KMS audit, signed rotation schedule, incident timeline, repro steps, and billing reconciliation. Will share link here when ready. :thumbsup:
